summary: Ship `.agentic/releases/unreleased/README.md` in the bundled template payload so greenfield `gh plate bootstrap --apply` satisfies the `agentic_releases` adoption check without a follow-up `import-payload`.
migration_impact: New greenfield bootstraps receive the same unreleased README as the #996 import seed. `conservative` and `safe` import skip an existing file at that path (including #996-seeded or custom text) instead of raising a payload conflict or escape hatch. Older template payloads without this file still get the adoption seed on import.
agent_notes: Template README must stay byte-identical to `MINIMAL_UNRELEASED_README` in import_payload so identical seeded copies skip under conservative. `_seed_releases_layout_if_missing` is a no-op for the README when the payload manifest includes the path; it still mkdir-backfills pre-#1461 templates.
